So the table lists for each A/B pair the resulting C and D tasks, distinct completed count, duplicate violations, total cost, rewards etc.

Our shared objective: maximize number of distinct tasks completed (i.e., distinct tasks among all four agents). Then minimize total execution cost across all four agents.
